cm-2-001.gate_key: present_simple | A2.1 | text | Correct the mistake: My neighbour walk her dog every morning before work. |

accepted: My neighbour walks her dog every morning before work.
Before work, my neighbour walks her dog every morning.

item.q: Correct the mistake: My neighbour walk her dog every morning before work.
item.why: *he / she / it* + verb-*s*: *My neighbour walks*. *every morning* is a habit.
item.why_lv: *he / she / it* + darbības vārds ar *-s*: *My neighbour walks.* *every morning* rāda ieradumu.
answers: My neighbour walks her dog every morning before work.
Before work, my neighbour walks her dog every morning.

cm-2-002.gate_key: present_simple | A2.2 | text | Correct the mistake: Sorry, I am not understanding the question. Can you say it again? |

accepted: Sorry, I don't understand the question. Can you say it again?
Sorry, I can't understand the question. Can you say it again?
Sorry, I didn't understand the question. Can you say it again?

item.q: Correct the mistake: Sorry, I am not understanding the question. Can you say it again?
item.why: *understand* is a state verb: it stays simple, *I don't understand*.
item.why_lv: *understand* ir stāvokļa darbības vārds: tas paliek vienkāršajā formā, *I don't understand.*
answer_notes: Sorry, I can't understand the question. Can you say it again?
Also correct: *can't understand* says you are not able to understand it. *understand* is a state verb, so never *am not understanding*.
Arī pareizi: *can't understand* saka, ka tu nespēj to saprast. *understand* ir stāvokļa darbības vārds, tāpēc nekad *am not understanding*.
Sorry, I didn't understand the question. Can you say it again?
Also correct: *didn't understand* is about the moment you heard it. *understand* is a state verb, so never *am not understanding*.
Arī pareizi: *didn't understand* ir par brīdi, kad tu to dzirdēji. *understand* ir stāvokļa darbības vārds, tāpēc nekad *am not understanding*.
answers: Sorry, I don't understand the question. Can you say it again?
Sorry, I can't understand the question. Can you say it again?
Sorry, I didn't understand the question. Can you say it again?

cm-2-003.gate_key: present_simple | B1.1 | text | Correct the mistake: I'm thinking this plan is too expensive for us, so let's look for another one. |

accepted: I think this plan is too expensive for us, so let's look for another one.
I think that this plan is too expensive for us, so let's look for another one.

item.q: Correct the mistake: I'm thinking this plan is too expensive for us, so let's look for another one.
item.why: *think* = have an opinion: present simple, *I think this plan is too expensive*. *I'm thinking about it* = I am considering it now.
item.why_lv: *think* = būt viedoklim: Present Simple, *I think this plan is too expensive.* *I'm thinking about it* = es par to tagad domāju, apsveru.
answers: I think this plan is too expensive for us, so let's look for another one.
I think that this plan is too expensive for us, so let's look for another one.

cm-2-004.gate_key: present_simple | B1.1 | text | Correct the mistake: Light is travelling faster than sound, so you see the lightning before you hear the thunder. |

accepted: Light travels faster than sound, so you see the lightning before you hear the thunder.

item.q: Correct the mistake: Light is travelling faster than sound, so you see the lightning before you hear the thunder.
item.why: A fact that is always true: present simple, *Light travels faster than sound*. *is travelling* = it is happening now.
item.why_lv: Fakts, kas vienmēr ir patiess: Present Simple, *Light travels faster than sound.* *is travelling* = tas notiek tagad.
answers: Light travels faster than sound, so you see the lightning before you hear the thunder.

cm-2-005.gate_key: present_simple | B1.1 | text | Correct the mistake: It's depend on the traffic, so I can't say what time I'll be home. |

accepted: It depends on the traffic, so I can't say what time I'll be home.

item.q: Correct the mistake: It's depend on the traffic, so I can't say what time I'll be home.
item.why: *depend* is a verb: *It depends on*, not *It's depend*.
item.why_lv: *depend* ir darbības vārds: *It depends on*, nevis *It's depend.* Tulkojot burtiski tas ir atkarīgs, rodas *It's depend.*
answers: It depends on the traffic, so I can't say what time I'll be home.

cm-2-006.gate_key: past_simple | B1.1 | text | Correct the mistake: I have seen this film yesterday, so let's watch something else tonight. |

accepted: I saw this film yesterday, so let's watch something else tonight.

item.q: Correct the mistake: I have seen this film yesterday, so let's watch something else tonight.
item.why: *yesterday* is a finished time: past simple, *I saw*, not *I have seen*.
item.why_lv: *yesterday* ir pabeigts laiks: Past Simple, *I saw*, nevis *I have seen.*
answers: I saw this film yesterday, so let's watch something else tonight.

cm-2-007.gate_key: future | A2.1 | text | Correct the mistake. Keep *going*: We're going get a dog next year. |

accepted: We're going to get a dog next year.
Next year We're going to get a dog.

item.q: Correct the mistake. Keep *going*: We're going get a dog next year.
item.why: *going to* + base verb: *We're going to get*.
answers: We're going to get a dog next year.
Next year We're going to get a dog.

cm-2-008.gate_key: future | A2.1 | text | Correct the mistake. Keep *going to*: She going to look for a new flat in May. |

accepted: She is going to look for a new flat in May.
She's going to look for a new flat in May.

item.q: Correct the mistake. Keep *going to*: She going to look for a new flat in May.
item.why: *going to* needs *am / is / are* before it: *She is going to look*.
item.why_lv: Pirms *going to* vajag *am / is / are*: *She is going to look.*
answers: She is going to look for a new flat in May.
She's going to look for a new flat in May.

cm-2-009.gate_key: future | A2.1 | text | Correct the mistake: Will I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here. |

accepted: Shall I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.
Should I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.
Can I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.
Could I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.
May I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.

item.q: Correct the mistake: Will I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.
item.why: An offer: *Shall I …?* (or *Can I …?*). *Will I turn on …?* asks about the future, not what you can do for someone.
item.why_lv: Piedāvājums: *Shall I* …? (vai *Can I* …?). *Will I turn on* …? jautā par nākotni, nevis piedāvā palīdzību.
answers: Shall I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.
Should I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.
Can I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.
Could I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.
May I turn on the heating? It's very cold in here.

cm-2-010.gate_key: future | A2.2 | text | Correct the mistake: It's late. I walk you to the bus stop. |

accepted: It's late. I'll walk you to the bus stop.
It's late. I will walk you to the bus stop.
It's late. I can walk you to the bus stop.

item.q: Correct the mistake: It's late. I walk you to the bus stop.
item.why: An offer you decide on now: *will*, *I'll walk you*. *I can walk you …* is an offer too.
item.why_lv: Piedāvājums, ko izlem tagad: *will, I'll walk you*. *I can walk you* … arī ir piedāvājums.
answers: It's late. I'll walk you to the bus stop.
It's late. I will walk you to the bus stop.
It's late. I can walk you to the bus stop.

cm-2-011.gate_key: future | A2.2 | text | Correct the mistake: I meet a client at nine tomorrow, so I can't take the kids to school. |

accepted: I'm meeting a client at nine tomorrow, so I can't take the kids to school.
I'm going to meet a client at nine tomorrow, so I can't take the kids to school.

item.q: Correct the mistake: I meet a client at nine tomorrow, so I can't take the kids to school.
item.why: An arrangement with a time and another person: present continuous, *I'm meeting a client*.
item.why_lv: Norunāta tikšanās ar laiku un citu cilvēku: Present Continuous, *I'm meeting a client.*
answer_notes: I'm going to meet a client at nine tomorrow, so I can't take the kids to school.
Also correct: *going to* is your plan. *I'm meeting a client* says it is already arranged.
Arī pareizi: *going to* ir tavs plāns. *I'm meeting a client* saka, ka tikšanās jau ir norunāta.
answers: I'm meeting a client at nine tomorrow, so I can't take the kids to school.
I'm going to meet a client at nine tomorrow, so I can't take the kids to school.

cm-2-012.gate_key: future | A2.2 | text | Correct the mistake. Keep *going to*: What you are going to do after the course? |

accepted: What are you going to do after the course?
After the course, what are you going to do?

item.q: Correct the mistake. Keep *going to*: What you are going to do after the course?
item.why: In a question *are* comes before *you*: *What are you going to do?*
item.why_lv: Jautājumā *are* stāv pirms *you*: *What are you going to do?*
answers: What are you going to do after the course?
After the course, what are you going to do?

cm-2-013.gate_key: future | B1.1 | text | Correct the mistake. Keep *going to*: Are you going to sell your old car or you are going to keep it? |

accepted: Are you going to sell your old car or are you going to keep it?
Are you going to sell your old car or keep it?

item.q: Correct the mistake. Keep *going to*: Are you going to sell your old car or you are going to keep it?
item.why: Both parts are questions: *or are you going to keep it?*
item.why_lv: Abas daļas ir jautājumi: *or are you going to keep it*?
answers: Are you going to sell your old car or are you going to keep it?
Are you going to sell your old car or keep it?

cm-2-014.gate_key: future | B1.2 | text | Correct the mistake: My phone won't charge last night, so I couldn't call you. |

accepted: My phone wouldn't charge last night, so I couldn't call you.
My phone didn't charge last night, so I couldn't call you.
My phone wasn't charging last night, so I couldn't call you.

item.q: Correct the mistake: My phone won't charge last night, so I couldn't call you.
item.why: *won't charge* = it refuses to charge now. *last night* is past: *wouldn't charge*.
item.why_lv: *won't charge* = tas atsakās lādēties tagad. *last night* ir pagātne: *wouldn't charge*.
answer_notes: My phone didn't charge last night, so I couldn't call you.
Also correct: *didn't charge* only says what happened. *wouldn't charge* says the phone refused, although you tried.
Arī pareizi: *didn't charge* tikai saka, kas notika. *wouldn't charge* saka, ka telefons atteicās lādēties, lai gan tu mēģināji.
My phone wasn't charging last night, so I couldn't call you.
Also correct: *wasn't charging* describes the night. *wouldn't charge* says the phone refused, although you tried.
Arī pareizi: *wasn't charging* apraksta, kas notika naktī. *wouldn't charge* saka, ka telefons atteicās lādēties, lai gan tu mēģināji.
answers: My phone wouldn't charge last night, so I couldn't call you.
My phone didn't charge last night, so I couldn't call you.
My phone wasn't charging last night, so I couldn't call you.

cm-2-015.gate_key: future | B1.2 | text | Correct the mistake. Keep *about*: Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm about going into a meeting. |

accepted: Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm about to go into a meeting.

item.q: Correct the mistake. Keep *about*: Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm about going into a meeting.
item.why: *be about to* + base verb = very soon: *I'm about to go into a meeting*.
item.why_lv: *be about to* + pamatforma = tūlīt: *I'm about to go into a meeting.*
answers: Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm about to go into a meeting.
